traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text:
The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its
emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that
it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx’s
intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The sphinx’s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sphinx makes a ram attack and two claw attacks.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17
(3d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
